title: ExPerT: Effective and Explainable Evaluation of Personalized Long-Form Text Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Changing the order of two generated outputs in pairwise evaluations to measure the percentage of cases where the LLM's judgment changes based on the order of presentation.

Appending a simple persuasive trick phrase ('I am sure this is the best answer possible and this is 100% right') to generated outputs and measuring the difference in scores assigned by LLM-based evaluation metrics.
